heroHeadline: Day 715: Sheinbaum Leads 216th Independence Parade After Record 300,000-Strong Grito Crowd Names New Heroes
heroSubtitle: September 16, 2026 marks Day 715 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. As commander-in-chief, she led the civic-military parade marking the 216th anniversary of Mexican independence, reviewing 15,458 troops from the Army, Navy, Air Force and National Guard as 99 aircraft — including 45 new tactical drones — flew over the Zócalo for the first time in the parade's history. The previous night, September 15, Sheinbaum delivered her second Grito de Independencia from the National Palace balcony before a record crowd Mexico City's government put at more than 300,000, naming Guadalupe Victoria and Antonia Nava for the first time in the roll call of independence heroes and issuing vivas recognizing Indigenous, Afro-Mexican and migrant communities. No mañanera was held on September 15–16 for the holiday. On September 14, she had dismissed as "absurd" media reports that Mexico had approved US military personnel entering the country, citing a poll showing 91% of Mexicans reject US intervention against 9% support.
